measured_weakness: The exact parser fails closed, but it emits no stable machine-readable reason for content rejection. Forty-nine retained model failures are therefore one opaque schema_invalid bucket, so any model or schema change would be selected by guesswork rather than failure-specific evidence.
smallest_bounded_improvement: Add a closed 17-code content-validation taxonomy to parser exceptions, propagate only the code into model metadata and evaluation aggregates, retain raw text only as a SHA-256 digest, and leave every outcome, parser acceptance rule, model prompt, schema, tool, approval, executor, and default-selection boundary unchanged.
non_claims: Failure classification does not improve model accuracy, utility, safety, or latency by itself.
The excluded baseline-0004 model result remains unfavorable and is not rewritten.
No local model may become the default without a separate frozen comparison and Pareto evidence.
